meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 将应用部署到 Vercel 并管理项目配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将前端应用部署到 Vercel 平台
copy.tagline_en: Deploy apps to Vercel and manage project settings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently deploy frontend apps to Vercel

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过命令行将网页应用部署到 Vercel，并管理项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当用户要求部署、发布或管理 Vercel 项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: Claude 会运行部署命令并检查结果。

say.text: 列出我 Vercel 账号下的所有项目。
say.note: Claude 会调用项目列表命令。

say.text: 给当前项目添加一个自定义域名。
say.note: Claude 会执行域名添加命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can deploy web apps to Vercel via CLI, and manage projects, domains, and environment variables.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to deploy, publish, or manage Vercel projects.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude runs the deploy command and checks the result.
Claude runs the project list command.

say_en.text: Add a custom domain to the current project.
say_en.note: Claude runs the domain add command.
